<!--
Thanks for opening a pull request. Replace the placeholders below and make
sure the checklist is complete before requesting a review.
-->

## Summary

- What does this pull request change?
- What issue or user need does it address?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or continuous-integration change

## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` reports no issues.
- [ ] `flutter test` passes.
- [ ] `dart format .` produced no changes.
- [ ] For Rust changes, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -D warnings` and `cargo check` pass.
- [ ] Public behaviour is covered by a test where practical.
- [ ] Documentation and comments are updated, using standard British English.
- [ ] The commit messages follow Conventional Commits (for example, `feat: add ...`).

## Additional notes

Anything reviewers should know, such as screenshots or follow-up work.
